page.layout: One page of text in a single main column; marginal notes in the left margin, beside the lower lines of the column. Running head at top centre.

main_text.p: fuam uenenofam dotationem funt pro maiori parte pertranfiti latam uiam. Corrollarium eft, oratio ualoris, procedens ex charitate perfecta, complecteretur in generali, omnes quos Deus uellet habere faluatos, & dimitteret uiam ufitatam nundinariam pro fpecialibus orationibus factam mendicantibus, poffeffionatis, & alijs facerdotibus conductitijs, qui funt populus ftrenuus ad operandum & inferuiendum toti regno, iam retentus in oo cio, quia fuit probatum in uno libro quem Rex habuit, quod centum domus eleemofynarum, sufficiunt toti regno : & ex hoc proueniret magis incrementum poffibile tempórali parti.

page.notes: Left margin notes are partly illegible; the marginal note "Compertu quod centu domus eleemofynarum toti regno Anglia fuficiunt." and the side number 8 with "Peregrinationes et oblationes" are transcribed as read. Several words in the margin are doubtful. Scan shows show-through at the upper left margin, omitted. Long s rendered as s.
